rows.note: Use 桃 as the all-purpose word for the peach fruit.
Use 桃紅色 when naming the light yellow-red colour rather than the fruit.

example.english: I want to paint the room peach.
example.traditional: 我想將間房髹做桃紅色。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zoeng1 gaan1 fong4 jau1 zou6 tou4 hung4 sik1

rows.note: Use 桃樹 specifically for the peach tree, not its fruit.

example.english: We planted a peach tree in the backyard.
example.traditional: 我哋喺後園種咗棵桃樹。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 hau6 jyun4 zung3 zo2 fo2 tou4 syu6
